availableCommands.name: google-workspace
availableCommands.description: Read this before the first Google Drive, Docs, Sheets or Slides connector call whenever the task creates or changes a Google file. Use this skill whenever the user wants to create or change a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides file in their Google Drive. Triggers include: a request that names Google Docs, Sheets, Slides or Drive and asks to make, edit, format, copy or rename a file; a docs.google.com link with a request to change that file, even a one-line fix or suggested edits; and any follow-up change to a Google file from earlier in the chat, even "change it" or "add a tab". Includes helper scripts for document positions, cell ranges and slide layout. However, if the user asks for a doc, deck or spreadsheet without naming Google, or gives a Google file only as source material for something new, use Claude's own output type instead. Do NOT use for read-only questions about a Google file, or for Word, Excel, PowerPoint or PDF files.

# Review candidate

Read-only. Do not repair or start another review.

## Specification
### P2.2 — Переименования и раскладка drive

**Intent:** Canonical drive FQNs and domain layout (OPUS 03 §4/04 §4), unused types removed, thin provider (R14).

**Why:** OPUS 13 P2.2; AD03/AD04.

**Scope Included:**
1. Apply every drive FQN rename and domain placement in Inputs 2–3 §4 and Required Reads 0;
   the complete Rector map implements them (R2). `StorageController::show` →
   `ShowDriveController::__invoke`; route path/name unchanged. Error codes remain canonical (P1.8).
2. Методы handle (03 §6, в части переименованных классов): `DriveHandle::storage()`→`model(): Drive`,
   `DriveHandle::panel()`→`profile(): Profile`; те же два метода интерфейса core и необходимые callers
   меняются в этом item (D20); остальные методы handle — без изменений (P3.2/P3.3).
3. Удаления: `ValueObjects\WorkspaceRef`, `Enums\BulkAction` (если используются в `src` — стоп и эскалация).
4. Extract unchanged provider registration and HTTP wiring into
   `packages/drive/src/Providers/{BindingsRegistrar,HttpRegistrar}.php`; isolated tests for each
   in `packages/drive/tests/Providers/` (R14).
5. Ссылки в documents/filament/core-тестах на перемещённые классы drive — новые FQN (Rector по той же карте).
   Restore the existing document rollback fixture key `version_no` in core Database/VaulterDatabaseTest;
   the schema/model are unchanged (finding P2.2-baseline-document-fixture).
6. Документация: `UPGRADE.md` (таблица п.1–п.3, AD03/AD04), `CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased]`, `docs/{guide,reference,ru}/**` — новые FQN (`docs/plan` — история, не меняется);
   golden `PublicApiSnapshotTest` (или snapshot пакета drive, если он ведётся отдельно).

**Scope Excluded:** новые Actions 03 §4 (`UpdateNodeAction`, `EmptyTrashAction`, `RestoreFileRevisionAction` — P3.3;
`InitiateUploadAction`/`AbortUploadAction` — P3.7; `ArchiveDriveAction`/`DeleteDriveAction` — P4.6); разбиение
`NodeController`/`DownloadController` (P6.1); `UploadModels` → `DriveConfig` (P2.5); удаление `RecordsDriveOutbox`/
`RecordsDriveActivity` (P5.1); сигнатуры `vaulter:sweep-uploads`/`vaulter:purge-trash` (P7.2); остальные изменения контракта `DriveHandle` (P3.2, D20).

**Inputs:** `plans/2026.09.29-№1-VAULTER-STABLE/artifacts/P2-design/P2.2-opus.md`;
`audits/2026-09-29-stable-audit/opus/03-glossary-and-renames.md` (§4); `audits/2026-09-29-stable-audit/opus/04-packages-and-layout.md` (§4);
`packages/drive/src/DriveHandle.php` (переименованный input P2.2, исходный digest сохранён в start snapshot); `packages/drive/tests/Arch/ArchTest.php`.

**Files:** конкретные затронутые файлы п.1–п.6 (brace/glob, включая native deletions); зависимости читаются отдельно:
`{CHANGELOG,UPGRADE}.md`,
`docs/{guide/{ar*,au*,dr*,er*,f*,int*,m*,q*,r*,storage-a*,tra*,u*}.md,reference/{cont*,e*,f*,r*}.md,ru/{concepts/a*.md,guide/{ar*,dr*,f*,int*,m*,q*,r*,st*,tra*,u*}.md,reference/{cont*,e*,f*,r*}.md}}`,
`packages/core/src/Contracts/Drive/DriveHandle.php`,
`packages/core/tests/{Database/V*.php,Access/{AccessA*,AccessT*}.php,Activity/R*.php,Arch/{A*.php,__snapshots__/**},Drive/**,E2E/E2eS*.php,IdStrategy/{Bigint/H*.php,Ulid/H*.php},Observability/P83/{P83A*,P83S*}.php,ObservabilityDocuments/P83DocumentsM*.php,Sharing/ShareS*.php,Support/U*.php,Ulid/**,Unit/W*.php,Upgrade/Fi*.php,Webhooks/{OutboxR*,OutboxS*}.php}`,
`packages/documents/tests/{Collaboration/{CollaborationW*,N*}.php,Document/{C*,DocumentC*,DocumentE*,DocumentN*,DocumentTestH*,DocumentTr*,Dom*,L*,NodeE*,NodeH*,P*,R*,S*,T*,V*}.php,Feature/**}`,
`packages/drive/src/{{DriveH*,DriveM*,DriveP*,V*}.php,Actions/{Files/**,Nodes/**,Trash/**,Uploads/Comp*.php},Activity/**,Console/**,Data/{Files/**,Nodes/**,Uploads/I*.php},Enums/B*.php,Events/{Drives/**,Files/**,Nodes/**,Uploads/**},Exceptions/{Nodes/**,Quota/**,Uploads/**},Http/{Controllers/{N*.php,Drives/**,Uploads/{S3MultipartP*,TusP*}.php},Requests/{Files/**,Folders/**,Nodes/**},Resources/{D*,FileR*}.php},Providers/**,Repositories/Uploads/UploadSessionS*.php,Uploads/**,ValueObjects/**,Webhooks/**}`,
`packages/drive/tests/{Pe*.php,Arch/__snapshots__/**,Concurrency/{D*,L*,M*,Q*,R*,T*}.php,Drive/{CopyM*,Cr*,F*,M*,R*,S*,T*,U*}.php,Feature/{D*,M*,O*,Q*,R*,T*,U*}.php,Observability/P84*.php,Panels/**,Providers/**,Uploads/{R*,S*,TusF*,UploadI*,UploadSessionA*,UploadSessionC*}.php}`,
`packages/drive/routes/**`,
`packages/filament/tests/Fixtures/D*.php`,
`plans/2026.09.29-№1-VAULTER-STABLE/artifacts/P2.2/{rename-map.php,rector-dry-run.txt}`.

**Required Reads:** 0) `plans/2026.09.29-№1-VAULTER-STABLE/artifacts/P2-design/P2.2-opus.md` (дословные требования OPUS — исполнить все,
кроме переданных по `note` ledger); 1) `packages/drive/src/DriveHandle.php` (переименованный input P2.2); 2) `packages/drive/src/VaulterDriveServiceProvider.php`;
3) `packages/drive/routes/drive.php`; 4) `packages/drive/tests/Arch/ArchTest.php`; 5) `plans/2026.09.29-№1-VAULTER-STABLE/artifacts/P2.1/rename-map.php` (producer: P2.1; формат карты).

**Authority:** routine

**Implementation Rules:**
- Rector `--dry-run` → лог → apply (R2); без алиасов (R3); поведение и маршруты (пути, имена) не меняются.
- ADR-0017 Law 1/2 arch-тесты drive остаются зелёными без новых исключений.

**Code Guidance:** остатки (ожидаемый вывод пуст):
`grep -rnE "Vaulter\\\\Drive\\\\(DriveContext|DriveManager|StorageManager|ValueObjects\\\\WorkspaceRef|Enums\\\\BulkAction|Actions\\\\[A-Z][A-Za-z]+Action\b|Data\\\\[A-Z][A-Za-z]+Data\b|Events\\\\(StorageCreated|NodeCreated|NodeForceDeleted|NodeVersionCommitted|UploadSession)|Exceptions\\\\[A-Z][A-Za-z]+Exception\b|Http\\\\Controllers\\\\StorageController|Http\\\\Resources\\\\(Storage|FileVersion)Resource|Support\\\\Uploads\\\\(MagicByteSniffer|StagedUpload))" packages/*/src packages/*/tests packages/*/routes docs/guide docs/reference docs/ru`
(`Actions\Uploads\…`, `Data\Uploads\…` и т.п. с доменной подпапкой не совпадают — шаблон требует класс сразу после слоя).

**Validation:**
- Code Guidance → пусто.
- Гейт drive, documents, filament и гейт core → exit 0; сетка P1 на PG → 0 failed, 0 skipped.
- `(cd packages/drive && env $SQ "$R/scripts/php84" vendor/bin/pest --ci tests/Arch tests/Providers)` → 0 failed.

**Deliverables:** раскладка и имена drive по 03 §4/04 §4 (в части P2); registrars drive; Rector-карта и dry-run-лог;
UPGRADE/CHANGELOG/golden.

availableCommands.name: google-workspace
availableCommands.description: Read this before the first Google Drive, Docs, Sheets or Slides connector call whenever the task creates or changes a Google file. Use this skill whenever the user wants to create or change a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides file in their Google Drive. Triggers include: a request that names Google Docs, Sheets, Slides or Drive and asks to make, edit, format, copy or rename a file; a docs.google.com link with a request to change that file, even a one-line fix or suggested edits; and any follow-up change to a Google file from earlier in the chat, even "change it" or "add a tab". Includes helper scripts for document positions, cell ranges and slide layout. However, if the user asks for a doc, deck or spreadsheet without naming Google, or gives a Google file only as source material for something new, use Claude's own output type instead. Do NOT use for read-only questions about a Google file, or for Word, Excel, PowerPoint or PDF files.

availableCommands.name: user:docs

Activate when adding/onboarding/syncing a project, editing .mcp.json, or choosing MCP — emits a justified connection plan, not a dump of every server.

availableCommands.name: node-pnpm-preflight
availableCommands.description: Check Node/pnpm availability on host before commands and git hooks that use pnpm (commitlint, lint, build).

availableCommands.name: plan-protocol
availableCommands.description: Use when an explicitly invoked Task plan command needs a schema reference.

availableCommands.name: query-craft
availableCommands.description: Use when a search query needs precision: concrete question, version, environment and source constraints.

availableCommands.name: find-skills
availableCommands.description: Use when the user explicitly asks to find, compare, or install an agent skill. Ordinary how-to or implementation requests do not activate this skill.

availableCommands.name: setup-writing-style
availableCommands.description: Learns how the user writes from their own sent messages and docs, and builds a voice profile so future drafts sound like them instead of generic AI. The profile is saved as the my-writing-style skill. Use when the user asks to set up, learn, or capture their writing voice, or complains that drafts sound generic or unlike them and no my-writing-style profile exists. Only for drafting text the user will send as themselves, not for Claude's own replies.

availableCommands.name: import-memory
availableCommands.description: Import a memory export from another AI assistant into Claude's memory — conversationally, additively, and with the content treated as data.

availableCommands.name: morning
availableCommands.description: Render the user's morning brief as a styled HTML artifact, or set it up as a recurring weekday task. Use only when the user explicitly asks to run, see, or set up their morning brief, or if they invoke /morning by name. A question about their day, schedule, or calendar is not by itself a request for the brief; answer it directly instead.

availableCommands.name: google-workspace
availableCommands.description: Read this before the first Google Drive, Docs, Sheets or Slides connector call whenever the task creates or changes a Google file. Use this skill whenever the user wants to create or change a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides file in their Google Drive. Triggers include: a request that names Google Docs, Sheets, Slides or Drive and asks to make, edit, format, copy or rename a file; a docs.google.com link with a request to change that file, even a one-line fix or suggested edits; and any follow-up change to a Google file from earlier in the chat, even "change it" or "add a tab". Includes helper scripts for document positions, cell ranges and slide layout. However, if the user asks for a doc, deck or spreadsheet without naming Google, or gives a Google file only as source material for something new, use Claude's own output type instead. Do NOT use for read-only questions about a Google file, or for Word, Excel, PowerPoint or PDF files.

availableCommands.name: user:docs
availableCommands.description: docs (editable docs people share and comment on; the default for any document, named as a doc or not: a document, report, proposal, resume, cover letter, letter, contract, policy, form, template, worksheet, essay, handbook, guide, how-to, cheat sheet, SOP or other writing to keep, share, collaborate on, send, submit, print or sign; a doc exports to Word, PDF, Markdown or Google Docs, so needing a file to send, attach, upload, submit or print is no reason to pick Word, and a file nobody asked for is a doc, not Word; a plan, comparison, summary or notes asked in chat stays in chat; a pasted claude.ai artifact link may be a doc: check with docs tools first; Word or another file format named, tracked changes wanted, or a .docx to change or use as a template → that format's skill): making one → if no docs-connector instructions are in context, call its `guide` (topic.instructions) first; then create the doc (headings only, no body) before any search, file read or plan, even with files attached.

10→# D20 — согласовать два метода DriveHandle в P2.2

**Actor:** владелец репозитория, текущая Codex-сессия.
**Evidence:** после предъявления `findings/P2.2-handle-contract-conflict.md` и двух
вариантов владелец поручил: «выстраивай как правильно, последовательность мне не
важна, важен финальный результат».

## Solution

Исполнитель выбирает второй предъявленный вариант: включить в P2.2 минимальную
20→смену двух методов интерфейса `packages/core/src/Contracts/Drive/DriveHandle.php`
и необходимых callers, чтобы полностью выполнить исходный результат P2.2:
`storage(): Drive` → `model(): Drive`, `panel(): string` → `profile(): Profile`.
Реализация возвращает зарегистрированный Profile через существующий
ProfileRegistry. Golden, UPGRADE и CHANGELOG обновляются в том же item.
Временные обёртки не добавляются; остальной объём P3.2 остаётся отдельным.

Удаление неиспользуемого WorkspaceRef включает удаление его orphan unit-test
в core: этот тест проверяет только удаляемый класс. HTTP Requests размещаются
по существующим доменам Folders/Files/Nodes без смены коротких имён.
30→
P2.2 и P2.3 исполняются в текущем root с Grok review и исходной Validation.
Публичные entry points Vaulter::for/forStorage, остальные методы handle,
поведение маршрутов и JSON не меняются. Push/publication не разрешаются.

## Why

Одновременная смена интерфейса и реализации сохраняет типизированный seam и
устраняет воспроизведённый PHP fatal. Она выполняет исходный результат P2.2 без
переходного API и не требует реализации будущих Operations/Actor-контрактов.
40→

## docs/adr/0017-package-structure-canon.md

SHA256 718ddeb8613fb227d0109565ad958b3ee4ea7b49b1dca6671946252164c6c282.

# ADR-0017 — Internal package structure canon (layer-first + domain sub-namespace)

**Status:** accepted
40→
> **Amendment (VLT-CANON P2.1).** The AzGuard bridge package was renamed
> `permissions-azgard` → **`azgard`** (`axioma-studio/vaulter-azgard`, namespace
> `Vaulter\Azgard\*`). This ADR's canon is unchanged — only the package's name is.
> Both mentions below are written in the current name.

## Context

vaulter is a monorepo of six PHP packages (`core`, `drive`, `media`, `documents`,
`filament`, `azgard`) over one shared kernel (ADR-0005 / ADR-0015).
50→Their internal `src/**` layout drifted into three incompatible schemes, which
breaks the layer-mirror navigation the monorepo depends on (VLT-REMED D10, owner
decision 2026-07-10):

1. **`vaulter-core` — layer-first + domain sub-namespace.** Technical layers
   (`Actions/`, `Models/`, `Repositories/`, `Enums/`, `Events/`, `Data/`,
   `Contracts/`, `Http/`, …) sit at the package root, and within each layer
   classes are grouped by a **domain** sub-namespace: `Actions/Sharing`,
   `Models/Drive`, `Enums/Webhooks`, `Http/Controllers/Access`. Cross-cutting
   domain services that do not fit a standard layer live in a top-level
60→   **domain-service folder** (`Access/`, `Sharing/`, `Webhooks/`, `Cas/`,
   `Activity/`). This is the reference scheme.
2. **`vaulter-drive` — domain-first island.** The `Uploads/` module carries its
   OWN nested layer tree (`Uploads/Actions`, `Uploads/Models`,
   `Uploads/Repositories`, `Uploads/Http`, `Uploads/Enums`, `Uploads/Data`,
   `Uploads/Contracts`) — the inverse of the core scheme (a layer nested UNDER a
   domain).
3. **`vaulter-documents` — flat layers.** Layers sit at the root (layer-first)
   but are **flat**: `Actions/` (9), `Events/` (6), `Data/` (6), `Enums/` (4),
   `Repositories/` (4), `Models/` (2) hold classes with no domain sub-namespace,
70→   plus a partly domain-first `Documents/` folder.

The full six-package inventory is in
`plans/archive/VLT-REMED/findings/P4.9-structure-inventory.md`.

This ADR **declares the canon**; it moves NO code. Enforcement is by Pest arch
tests added in the same change (VLT-REMED P4.9); the physical namespace refactor
that makes every package conform is a separate, reviewed step (VLT-REMED P4.10,
`php:namespace-refactor-safety`). Declaration and execution are split so the
canon is reviewed BEFORE the irreversible mass-move.
80→
## Decision

**Canon A: layer-first placement + domain sub-namespace within layers.** The
reference is `vaulter-core`. Two structural laws, both machine-checked:

- **Law 1 — layer-first placement.** A recognized technical-layer directory
  (`Actions`, `Models`, `Repositories`, `Enums`, `Events`, `Data`, `Contracts`,
  `Http`) lives as the FIRST namespace segment under the package root
  (`Vaulter\<Pkg>\Actions\…`). A layer directory MUST NOT be nested inside a
90→  domain module folder (`src/Uploads/Actions` is a violation; `src/Actions/Uploads`
  is canonical). Sub-layers of `Http` (`Http/Controllers`, `Http/Requests`,
  `Http/Resources`, `Http/Middleware`, `Http/Support`) are structural, not
  domains, and are allowed.
- **Law 2 — domain sub-namespace within layers.** Inside a multi-domain layer,
  classes are grouped under a **domain** sub-namespace (`Actions/<Domain>/Class`),
  not placed flat directly in the layer root. A SHORT, explicit allow-list of
  cross-cutting root-citizens may stay flat at a layer root — currently
  `Contracts/IdStrategy` and `Exceptions/VaulterException` (the base exception).

100→**Allowed outside the two laws:**

- **Package entrypoints at `src/` root:** `*ServiceProvider`, `*Manager`,
  `*Context`, `*Plugin`, the facade seam, and a small models/config helper
  (`VaulterManager`, `DriveManager`, `DriveContext`, `StorageManager`,
  `DocumentsModels`, …).
- **Domain-service folders at `src/` root** for domain services/resolvers that do
  not belong to a standard layer — `core/src/{Access,Sharing,Webhooks,Cas,Activity}`
  is the reference shape. These are domain-named, NOT layer-named, so Law 1 does
  not apply to them.
110→
**Target layers per package (the canonical set):** `Actions/`, `Models/`,
`Repositories/`, `Enums/`, `Events/`, `Data/`, `Contracts/`, `Http/` (with
`Controllers`/`Requests`/`Resources`/`Middleware`/`Support` sub-layers),
`Exceptions/`, `Jobs/`, `Policies/`, `Rules/`, `ValueObjects/`, `Console/`,
`Support/`, plus package-specific structural roots (`Drivers/`, `Schema/`,
`Panels/`, `Attributes/`, `Facades/`, `Testing/` in core).

**Exceptions (explicitly out of Canon A):**

120→- **`vaulter-filament`** follows the **Filament** plugin convention
  (`src/Resources/<XResource>/Pages/`), which is itself a canon owned by the
  framework. Canon A does NOT apply; P4.10 does not restructure it.
- **`vaulter-media`** and **`vaulter-azgard`** are minimal (a CAS
  domain-service folder / a guard adapter). They conform to Canon A in its narrow
  form; P4.10 only verifies them, it does not force a layer tree onto packages
  that have none.

**Enforcement (this change, P4.9):**

130→- `packages/core/tests/Arch/ArchTest.php` — Law 2 is already enforced green by
  the existing `split technical roots keep classes in domain subfolders` test;
  P4.9 adds an executable **Law 1 green-guard** tagged to this ADR.
- `packages/documents/tests/Arch/ArchTest.php` — a **Law 2** canon test, RED on
  the current flat layout, marked `->todo()` ("unblocked by P4.10 / ADR-0017").
- `packages/drive/tests/Arch/ArchTest.php` — a **Law 1** canon test, RED on the
  current `Uploads/*` layout, marked `->todo()` ("unblocked by P4.10 / ADR-0017").

The `->todo()` markers are the executable spec of the P4.10 scope: P4.10 makes
them pass by moving code, then removes the `->todo()`.
140→
## Consequences

- The canon is an **executable specification**, not prose: a regression that
  drops a class back into a flat layer root (Law 2) or nests a layer under a
  domain (Law 1) trips an arch test naming the exact offender.
- `documents` and `drive` carry a KNOWN, encoded structural debt: their canon
  arch tests are red-in-principle (`->todo()`), so the debt is visible in the
  test report and cannot be silently forgotten. P4.10 discharges it.
- **Breaking change on execution (D3 — package unreleased, no BC obligation):**
150→  P4.10 changes public FQCNs (`Vaulter\Drive\Uploads\Actions\CommitUploadAction`
  → `Vaulter\Drive\Actions\Uploads\CommitUploadAction`, the documents flat
  classes gain a domain segment). Morph aliases, `config/vaulter.php` FQCN
  defaults, and docs references must move with the classes; recorded in
  `UPGRADE.md`. P4.9 itself changes NO code and breaks nothing.
- `filament` staying on the Filament convention is a deliberate, documented
  exception, not drift — future audits should not flag it against Canon A.

# Vaulter — инструкции для агентов

Vaulter — PHP-монорепозиторий пакетов Laravel. Работай только в затронутом пакете
`packages/<name>/`; не меняй соседние пакеты и не перезаписывай чужие изменения.

# ADR-0017 — Internal package structure canon (layer-first + domain sub-namespace)

**Status:** accepted

> **Amendment (VLT-CANON P2.1).** The AzGuard bridge package was renamed
> `permissions-azgard` → **`azgard`** (`axioma-studio/vaulter-azgard`, namespace
> `Vaulter\Azgard\*`). This ADR's canon is unchanged — only the package's name is.
> Both mentions below are written in the current name.

## Context

vaulter is a monorepo of six PHP packages (`core`, `drive`, `media`, `documents`,
`filament`, `azgard`) over one shared kernel (ADR-0005 / ADR-0015).
Their internal `src/**` layout drifted into three incompatible schemes, which
breaks the layer-mirror navigation the monorepo depends on (VLT-REMED D10, owner
decision 2026-07-10):

1. **`vaulter-core` — layer-first + domain sub-namespace.** Technical layers
   (`Actions/`, `Models/`, `Repositories/`, `Enums/`, `Events/`, `Data/`,
   `Contracts/`, `Http/`, …) sit at the package root, and within each layer
   classes are grouped by a **domain** sub-namespace: `Actions/Sharing`,
   `Models/Drive`, `Enums/Webhooks`, `Http/Controllers/Access`. Cross-cutting
   domain services that do not fit a standard layer live in a top-level
   **domain-service folder** (`Access/`, `Sharing/`, `Webhooks/`, `Cas/`,
   `Activity/`). This is the reference scheme.
2. **`vaulter-drive` — domain-first island.** The `Uploads/` module carries its
   OWN nested layer tree (`Uploads/Actions`, `Uploads/Models`,
   `Uploads/Repositories`, `Uploads/Http`, `Uploads/Enums`, `Uploads/Data`,
   `Uploads/Contracts`) — the inverse of the core scheme (a layer nested UNDER a
   domain).
3. **`vaulter-documents` — flat layers.** Layers sit at the root (layer-first)
   but are **flat**: `Actions/` (9), `Events/` (6), `Data/` (6), `Enums/` (4),
   `Repositories/` (4), `Models/` (2) hold classes with no domain sub-namespace,
   plus a partly domain-first `Documents/` folder.

The full six-package inventory is in
`plans/archive/VLT-REMED/findings/P4.9-structure-inventory.md`.

This ADR **declares the canon**; it moves NO code. Enforcement is by Pest arch
tests added in the same change (VLT-REMED P4.9); the physical namespace refactor
that makes every package conform is a separate, reviewed step (VLT-REMED P4.10,
`php:namespace-refactor-safety`). Declaration and execution are split so the
canon is reviewed BEFORE the irreversible mass-move.

## Decision

**Canon A: layer-first placement + domain sub-namespace within layers.** The
reference is `vaulter-core`. Two structural laws, both machine-checked:

- **Law 1 — layer-first placement.** A recognized technical-layer directory
  (`Actions`, `Models`, `Repositories`, `Enums`, `Events`, `Data`, `Contracts`,
  `Http`) lives as the FIRST namespace segment under the package root
  (`Vaulter\<Pkg>\Actions\…`). A layer directory MUST NOT be nested inside a
  domain module folder (`src/Uploads/Actions` is a violation; `src/Actions/Uploads`
  is canonical). Sub-layers of `Http` (`Http/Controllers`, `Http/Requests`,
  `Http/Resources`, `Http/Middleware`, `Http/Support`) are structural, not
  domains, and are allowed.
- **Law 2 — domain sub-namespace within layers.** Inside a multi-domain layer,
  classes are grouped under a **domain** sub-namespace (`Actions/<Domain>/Class`),
  not placed flat directly in the layer root. A SHORT, explicit allow-list of
  cross-cutting root-citizens may stay flat at a layer root — currently
  `Contracts/IdStrategy` and `Exceptions/VaulterException` (the base exception).

**Allowed outside the two laws:**

- **Package entrypoints at `src/` root:** `*ServiceProvider`, `*Manager`,
  `*Context`, `*Plugin`, the facade seam, and a small models/config helper
  (`VaulterManager`, `DriveManager`, `DriveContext`, `StorageManager`,
  `DocumentsModels`, …).
- **Domain-service folders at `src/` root** for domain services/resolvers that do
  not belong to a standard layer — `core/src/{Access,Sharing,Webhooks,Cas,Activity}`
  is the reference shape. These are domain-named, NOT layer-named, so Law 1 does
  not apply to them.

**Target layers per package (the canonical set):** `Actions/`, `Models/`,
`Repositories/`, `Enums/`, `Events/`, `Data/`, `Contracts/`, `Http/` (with
`Controllers`/`Requests`/`Resources`/`Middleware`/`Support` sub-layers),
`Exceptions/`, `Jobs/`, `Policies/`, `Rules/`, `ValueObjects/`, `Console/`,
`Support/`, plus package-specific structural roots (`Drivers/`, `Schema/`,
`Panels/`, `Attributes/`, `Facades/`, `Testing/` in core).

**Exceptions (explicitly out of Canon A):**

- **`vaulter-filament`** follows the **Filament** plugin convention
  (`src/Resources/<XResource>/Pages/`), which is itself a canon owned by the
  framework. Canon A does NOT apply; P4.10 does not restructure it.
- **`vaulter-media`** and **`vaulter-azgard`** are minimal (a CAS
  domain-service folder / a guard adapter). They conform to Canon A in its narrow
  form; P4.10 only verifies them, it does not force a layer tree onto packages
  that have none.

**Enforcement (this change, P4.9):**

- `packages/core/tests/Arch/ArchTest.php` — Law 2 is already enforced green by
  the existing `split technical roots keep classes in domain subfolders` test;
  P4.9 adds an executable **Law 1 green-guard** tagged to this ADR.
- `packages/documents/tests/Arch/ArchTest.php` — a **Law 2** canon test, RED on
  the current flat layout, marked `->todo()` ("unblocked by P4.10 / ADR-0017").
- `packages/drive/tests/Arch/ArchTest.php` — a **Law 1** canon test, RED on the
  current `Uploads/*` layout, marked `->todo()` ("unblocked by P4.10 / ADR-0017").

The `->todo()` markers are the executable spec of the P4.10 scope: P4.10 makes
them pass by moving code, then removes the `->todo()`.

## Consequences

- The canon is an **executable specification**, not prose: a regression that
  drops a class back into a flat layer root (Law 2) or nests a layer under a
  domain (Law 1) trips an arch test naming the exact offender.
- `documents` and `drive` carry a KNOWN, encoded structural debt: their canon
  arch tests are red-in-principle (`->todo()`), so the debt is visible in the
  test report and cannot be silently forgotten. P4.10 discharges it.
- **Breaking change on execution (D3 — package unreleased, no BC obligation):**
  P4.10 changes public FQCNs (`Vaulter\Drive\Uploads\Actions\CommitUploadAction`
  → `Vaulter\Drive\Actions\Uploads\CommitUploadAction`, the documents flat
  classes gain a domain segment). Morph aliases, `config/vaulter.php` FQCN
  defaults, and docs references must move with the classes; recorded in
  `UPGRADE.md`. P4.9 itself changes NO code and breaks nothing.
- `filament` staying on the Filament convention is a deliberate, documented
  exception, not drift — future audits should not flag it against Canon A.

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\Contracts\Drive;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Vaulter\Models\Drive\Drive;
use Vaulter\Models\Drive\Node;
use Vaulter\Profiles\Profile;

/**
 * The ergonomic Drive handle bound to one (Storage, panel) — the surface
 * `Vaulter::for($entity)` / `Vaulter::forStorage($storage)` returns (§2.1).
 *
 * The contract lives in core (the kernel owns the Node/Storage models and the
 * public facade entry point) while the concrete handle ships in vaulter-drive
 * (P2 #5 / ADR-0015): core defines what a handle CAN do, the drive package binds
 * the implementation. A host that has not installed vaulter-drive still type-hints
 * against this interface; resolving it fails loudly with an install hint.
 */
interface DriveHandle
{
    public function model(): Drive;

    public function profile(): Profile;

    /**
     * The storage's root folder node (§2.1).
     */
    public function root(): Node;

    public function createFolder(string $name, ?Node $parent = null, int|string|null $actorId = null): Node;

    /**
     * Upload bytes into the Drive (§2.4). $source may be a PSR StreamInterface, an
     * SplFileInfo / UploadedFile, an open stream resource, or a raw string.
     */
    public function upload(
        mixed $source,
        ?Node $into = null,
        ?string $name = null,
        ?string $mimeType = null,
        ?string $originalName = null,
        int|string|null $actorId = null,

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\Drive;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use RuntimeException;
use SplFileInfo;
use Vaulter\Contracts\Drive\DriveHandle as DriveHandleContract;
use Vaulter\Drive\Actions\Files\IngestFileAction;
use Vaulter\Drive\Actions\Nodes\CopyNodeAction;
use Vaulter\Drive\Actions\Nodes\CreateFolderAction;
use Vaulter\Drive\Actions\Nodes\MoveNodeAction;
use Vaulter\Drive\Actions\Nodes\RenameNodeAction;
use Vaulter\Drive\Actions\Trash\PurgeNodeAction;
use Vaulter\Drive\Actions\Trash\RestoreNodeAction;
use Vaulter\Drive\Actions\Trash\TrashNodeAction;
use Vaulter\Drive\Data\Files\IngestFileInput;
use Vaulter\Drive\Data\Nodes\CopyNodeInput;
use Vaulter\Drive\Data\Nodes\CreateFolderInput;
use Vaulter\Drive\Data\Nodes\MoveNodeInput;
use Vaulter\Drive\Data\Nodes\RenameNodeInput;
use Vaulter\Models\Drive\Drive;
use Vaulter\Models\Drive\Node;
use Vaulter\Profiles\Profile;
use Vaulter\Profiles\ProfileRegistry;
use Vaulter\Repositories\Drive\NodeReadRepository;

/**
 * The ergonomic Drive handle bound to one (Storage, panel) for a host entity —
 * the surface `Vaulter::for($entity)` returns. Every method is a thin delegation
 * to a final readonly Action (write) or NodeReadRepository (read); the handle adds
 * no business logic, only the convenience of a pre-resolved storage + the
 * stream-normalisation that keeps the Actions free of HTTP/PSR types.
 *
 * Authorization (M2a / H.2) is enforced at the HTTP controller boundary
 * (NodeController + AccessResolver) before these methods are reached — the handle
 * itself stays a pure delegation surface and performs no access checks, mirroring
 * the legacy DocumentVisibilityService placement canon.
 */
final readonly class DriveHandle implements DriveHandleContract
{
    public function __construct(
        private Drive $storage,
        private ProfileRegistry $profiles,
        private DriveProvisioner $storages,
        private NodeReadRepository $nodes,
        private CreateFolderAction $createFolder,
        private IngestFileAction $uploadFile,
        private MoveNodeAction $moveNode,
        private RenameNodeAction $renameNode,
        private CopyNodeAction $copyNode,
        private TrashNodeAction $trashNode,
        private RestoreNodeAction $restoreNode,
        private PurgeNodeAction $forceDeleteNode,
    ) {}

    public function model(): Drive
    {
        return $this->storage;
    }

    public function profile(): Profile
    {
        return $this->profiles->get($this->storage->profile);
    }

    /**
     * The storage's root folder node (§2.1).
     */
    public function root(): Node
    {
        return $this->storages->root($this->storage);
    }

    public function createFolder(string $name, ?Node $parent = null, int|string|null $actorId = null): Node
    {
        return $this->createFolder->execute(new CreateFolderInput(
            storage: $this->storage,
            name: $name,
            parent: $parent ?? $this->root(),
            actorId: $actorId,
        ));
    }

    /**
     * Upload bytes into the Drive (§2.4). $source may be a PSR StreamInterface, an
     * SplFileInfo / UploadedFile, an open stream resource, or a raw string — all
     * normalised to a seekable resource before the Action stages and dedups it.
     * $into is the destination folder (null = root); $name overrides the stored
     * name. Typed mixed so core need not hard-require psr/http-message.
     */
    public function upload(
        mixed $source,
        ?Node $into = null,
        ?string $name = null,
        ?string $mimeType = null,
        ?string $originalName = null,
        int|string|null $actorId = null,
    ): Node {
        $stream = $this->toStream($source);
        $resolvedOriginalName = $originalName ?? $this->originalNameFor($source) ?? ($name ?? 'upload.bin');

        return $this->uploadFile->execute(new IngestFileInput(
            storage: $this->storage,
            stream: $stream,
            originalName: $resolvedOriginalName,
            mimeType: $mimeType ?? $this->mimeTypeFor($source),
            into: $into ?? $this->root(),
            name: $name,
            actorId: $actorId,
        ));
    }

    /**
     * Upload a NEW VERSION onto an existing file node (§2.4): number bumps,
     * the head repoints, the prior version is superseded.
     */
    public function uploadVersion(
        Node $target,
        mixed $source,
        ?string $mimeType = null,
        ?string $originalName = null,
        int|string|null $actorId = null,
    ): Node {
        $stream = $this->toStream($source);
        $resolvedOriginalName = $originalName ?? $this->originalNameFor($source) ?? $target->name;

        return $this->uploadFile->execute(new IngestFileInput(
            storage: $this->storage,
            stream: $stream,
            originalName: $resolvedOriginalName,
            mimeType: $mimeType ?? $this->mimeTypeFor($source),
            targetNode: $target,
            actorId: $actorId,
        ));
    }

    public function move(Node $node, ?Node $into = null, int|string|null $actorId = null): Node
    {
        return $this->moveNode->execute(new MoveNodeInput(
            node: $node,
            into: $into ?? $this->root(),
            actorId: $actorId,
        ));
    }

    public function rename(Node $node, string $name, int|string|null $actorId = null): Node
    {
        return $this->renameNode->execute(new RenameNodeInput(
            node: $node,
            name: $name,
            actorId: $actorId,
        ));
    }

    public function copy(Node $node, ?Node $into = null, ?string $name = null, int|string|null $actorId = null): Node
    {
        return $this->copyNode->execute(new CopyNodeInput(
            node: $node,
            into: $into ?? $this->root(),
            name: $name,
            actorId: $actorId,
        ));
    }

    public function trash(Node $node, int|string|null $actorId = null): Node
    {
        return $this->trashNode->execute(node: $node, actorId: $actorId);
    }

    public function restore(Node $node, int|string|null $actorId = null): Node
    {
        return $this->restoreNode->execute(node: $node, actorId: $actorId);
    }

    public function forceDelete(Node $node, int|string|null $actorId = null): void
    {
        $this->forceDeleteNode->execute(node: $node, actorId: $actorId);
    }

    /**
     * Direct children of a folder (or the root when null) — the hot listing.
     *
     * @return Collection<int, Node>
     */
    public function list(?Node $folder = null): Collection
    {
        return $this->nodes->children(storage: $this->storage, parent: $folder ?? $this->root())->get();
    }

    /**
     * Normalise an upload source to a seekable byte stream resource. A PSR
     * StreamInterface is detached / re-read; an SplFileInfo / UploadedFile is
     * opened; an already-open resource is used as-is.
     *
     * @return resource
     */
    private function toStream(mixed $source): mixed
    {
        if (is_resource($source)) {
            return $source;
        }

        // PSR-7 StreamInterface — detected without a hard dependency: core does
        // not require psr/http-message, so we guard on its presence at runtime.
        if (is_object($source) && is_a($source, 'Psr\Http\Message\StreamInterface')) {
            return $this->streamFromString((string) $source);
        }

        if ($source instanceof SplFileInfo) {
            $handle = @fopen($source->getPathname(), 'rb');

            if ($handle === false) {
                throw new RuntimeException("Unable to open upload source [{$source->getPathname()}].");
            }

            return $handle;
        }

        if (is_string($source)) {
            return $this->streamFromString($source);
        }

        throw new RuntimeException(
            'Vaulter upload source must be a stream resource, PSR StreamInterface, SplFileInfo/UploadedFile or string.',
        );
    }

    /**
     * @return resource
     */
    private function streamFromString(string $bytes): mixed
    {
        $stream = fopen('php://temp', 'r+b');

        if ($stream === false) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Unable to open an in-memory stream for the upload.');
        }

        fwrite($stream, $bytes);
        rewind($stream);

        return $stream;
    }

    private function originalNameFor(mixed $source): ?string
    {
        if ($source instanceof SplFileInfo) {
            // UploadedFile exposes the client's original filename; SplFileInfo
            // falls back to the on-disk basename.
            if (method_exists($source, 'getClientOriginalName')) {
                /** @var string $name */
                $name = $source->getClientOriginalName();

                return $name;
            }

            return $source->getFilename();
        }

        return null;
    }

    private function mimeTypeFor(mixed $source): ?string
    {
        if ($source instanceof SplFileInfo && method_exists($source, 'getMimeType')) {
            /** @var string|null $mime */
            $mime = $source->getMimeType();

            return $mime;
        }

        return null;
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

use Illuminate\Routing\Middleware\SubstituteBindings;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use Vaulter\Drive\Http\Controllers\DownloadController;
use Vaulter\Drive\Http\Controllers\Drives\ShowDriveController;
use Vaulter\Drive\Http\Controllers\NodeController;
use Vaulter\Drive\Http\Controllers\Uploads\S3MultipartProtocolController;
use Vaulter\Drive\Http\Controllers\Uploads\TusProtocolController;
use Vaulter\Http\Middleware\ResolveVaulterRouteParameters;
use Vaulter\Support\Config;

/*
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------
| Vaulter Drive API routes (P2 #5 / ADR-0015, D1)
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------
| The file/folder tree + resumable-upload surface, extracted from core's
| routes/api.php into the vaulter-drive package. Mounted under the SAME configured
| prefix (default: api/vaulter) and middleware as the kernel routes — Laravel merges
| the two group registrations. The local resource middleware resolves {storage}
| and {node} through swappable core repositories before SubstituteBindings. All paths are distinct literals / differ in segment count from the
| kernel + documents routes, so cross-file registration order never shadows them.
*/

Route::prefix(Config::routePrefix())
    ->middleware(Config::authenticatedMiddleware())
    ->group(static function (): void {
        Route::middleware([ResolveVaulterRouteParameters::class, SubstituteBindings::class])->group(static function (): void {
            // "Shared with me" (§2.6 / H.2) — CROSS-STORAGE: not storage-bound, so it
            // sits at the top level. Gated on the 'grants' feature; the fixed segment
            // sits before the catch-all /{node} routes so it never shadows them.
            if (Config::featureEnabled('grants')) {
                Route::get('shared', [NodeController::class, 'shared']);
            }

            Route::get('storages/{storage}', ShowDriveController::class);

            Route::get('storages/{storage}/nodes', [NodeController::class, 'index']);
            Route::get('storages/{storage}/search', [NodeController::class, 'search']);
            Route::get('storages/{storage}/trash', [NodeController::class, 'trashed']);
            Route::post('storages/{storage}/folders', [NodeController::class, 'storeFolder']);
            Route::post('storages/{storage}/uploads', [NodeController::class, 'upload']);

            /*
            |------------------------------------------------------------------
            | Resumable uploads (§2.8 / D16 / M3a)
            |------------------------------------------------------------------
            | Large files upload resumably, then the assembled staged bytes go
            | through the SAME race-free BlobStore.commit (H.3). Gated on the
            | 'uploads' feature. {upload_id} is the client UNIQUE handle (a plain
            | scalar, NOT route-model bound — the controller resolves the session
            | and asserts it belongs to an authorized target). tus group: create
            | (POST), HEAD (Upload-Offset), PATCH (chunk), DELETE (abort), status
            | (GET), OPTIONS (discovery, F-P1.4-07 — unauthorized/unauthenticated
            | per the CORE protocol). S3 group: parts (POST), complete (POST).
            | Authorized via AccessResolver — Create in the target folder / Edit
            | for a new version.
            |
            | Rate-limited (P1.3 / F-P1.8-01) by the package's own `vaulter-uploads`
            | named limiter (config('vaulter.rate_limits.uploads'), keyed by actor id —
            | falling back to IP when unauthenticated) — a DoS lever distinct from the
            | max-active-sessions cap (F-P1.4-09, enforced in UploadSessionManager).
            */
            if (Config::featureEnabled('uploads')) {
                Route::middleware('throttle:vaulter-uploads')->group(static function (): void {
                    // tus.io CORE — create lives under the storage; the resumable ops
                    // address the session by its upload_id handle.
                    Route::post('storages/{storage}/resumable-uploads', [TusProtocolController::class, 'create']);

                    Route::get('resumable-uploads/{upload_id}', [TusProtocolController::class, 'status']);
                    Route::match(['head'], 'resumable-uploads/{upload_id}', [TusProtocolController::class, 'head']);
                    Route::patch('resumable-uploads/{upload_id}', [TusProtocolController::class, 'patch']);
                    Route::delete('resumable-uploads/{upload_id}', [TusProtocolController::class, 'abort']);
                    // tus OPTIONS discovery (F-P1.4-07) — answerable for ANY {upload_id}
                    // literal, resolved or not: the CORE protocol requires this endpoint
                    // to advertise capabilities WITHOUT resolving a session.
                    Route::options('resumable-uploads/{upload_id}', [TusProtocolController::class, 'options']);

                    // S3-style multipart — parts + complete on the same session handle.
                    Route::post('resumable-uploads/{upload_id}/parts', [S3MultipartProtocolController::class, 'parts']);
                    Route::post('resumable-uploads/{upload_id}/complete', [S3MultipartProtocolController::class, 'complete']);
                });
            }

            // The unified node tree (§2.2). The catch-all /{node} routes sit AFTER the
            // fixed sub-segments above (and after the kernel/documents fixed segments in
            // routes/api.php — different segment counts, so order across files is safe).
            Route::get('nodes/{node}', [NodeController::class, 'show']);
            Route::patch('nodes/{node}', [NodeController::class, 'rename']);
            Route::post('nodes/{node}/move', [NodeController::class, 'move']);
            Route::post('nodes/{node}/copy', [NodeController::class, 'copy']);
            Route::post('nodes/{node}/restore', [NodeController::class, 'restore']);
            Route::delete('nodes/{node}/force', [NodeController::class, 'forceDelete']);
            Route::delete('nodes/{node}', [NodeController::class, 'trash']);

            Route::get('nodes/{node}/download', [DownloadController::class, 'current']);
            Route::get('nodes/{node}/versions/{version}/download', [DownloadController::class, 'version']);
        });
    });

declare(strict_types=1);

// The drive package is strict-typed end to end.
arch('strict types')
    ->expect('Vaulter\Drive')
    ->toUseStrictTypes();

// T11 — drive and documents are independent siblings over core: nothing under
// Vaulter\Drive may reach into the documents engine. The Drive node read shape that
// embedded the document handler descriptor moved to core (Http\Resources\Drive\
// NodeResource) precisely so this stays true.
arch('drive never depends on documents')
    ->expect('Vaulter\Drive')

// E5.1 / F-P4.3-01 — declarative form kept for discoverability/grep (`toUse('App')`);
// see the file-scan test below (and core's ArchTest.php) for why this namespace-graph
// form cannot itself observe a real "uses" edge in this dev/test environment.
arch('the package never depends on the host application (E5.1)')
    ->expect('Vaulter\Drive')
    ->not->toUse('App');

/**
 * E5.1 / F-P4.3-01 — vaulter-drive is an embeddable Laravel package: it must never
 * reach into the HOST application's namespace. File scan (not
 * `expect(...)->not->toUse('App')`) because `App\*` is never an autoloadable class in
 * the package's own dev/test environment (red-before proven on core's ArchTest.php).
 */
test('non-test src never references the host App namespace (E5.1, F-P4.3-01)', function (): void {
    $src = __DIR__.'/../../src';
    $offenders = [];

    /** @var Iterator<SplFileInfo> $files */
    $files = new RegexIterator(
        new RecursiveIteratorIterator(new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($src)),
        '/\.php$/',
    );

    foreach ($files as $file) {
        $contents = file_get_contents($file->getPathname());

        if ($contents === false) {
            continue;
        }

        $code = '';

        foreach (token_get_all($contents) as $token) {
            if (is_array($token) && in_array($token[0], [T_COMMENT, T_DOC_COMMENT], true)) {
                continue;
            }

            $code .= is_array($token) ? $token[1] : $token;
        }

        if (preg_match('/\\bApp\\\\/', $code) === 1) {
            $offenders[] = $file->getPathname();
        }
    }

    expect($offenders)->toBe([]);
});

/**
 * ADR-0017 / VLT-REMED P4.9 + P4.10 — Canon A, Law 1 (layer-first placement).
 *
 * `drive` was DIVERGENT: the `Uploads/` module carried its own nested layer tree
 * (`Uploads/Actions`, `Uploads/Models`, `Uploads/Repositories`, `Uploads/Http`,
 * `Uploads/Enums`, `Uploads/Data`, `Uploads/Contracts`) — a layer nested UNDER a
 * domain, the inverse of the core canon. P4.10 DISCHARGED it: those layer
 * subtrees were dissolved into the package-root layers with an `Uploads` domain
 * sub-namespace (`Actions/Uploads`, `Models/Uploads`, `Repositories/Uploads`,
 * `Enums/Uploads`, `Data/Uploads`, `Contracts/Uploads`, `Http/<sub>/Uploads`); the
 * flat upload service classes stayed as the `Uploads/` domain-service folder
 * (mirrors `core/src/Sharing`). This test now asserts the CANON and passes GREEN;
 * the `->todo()` was removed by P4.10.
 *
 * Red-before proven (P4.9): before the move, this body failed with offenders
 * `Uploads/Actions`, `Uploads/Contracts`, `Uploads/Data`, `Uploads/Enums`,
 * `Uploads/Http`, `Uploads/Http/Controllers`, `Uploads/Http/Requests`,
 * `Uploads/Http/Resources`, `Uploads/Models`, `Uploads/Repositories`.
 *
 * VLT-CANON P2.3 further split the `Uploads/` domain-service folder by role:
 * `*Handler`/`*Manager` orchestrators (`TusUploadHandler`, `S3MultipartHandler`,
 * `UploadSessionManager`) stayed; the pure helpers (`MagicByteSniffer`,
 * `StagedUpload`, `UploadModels`) moved to `Support/Uploads` — still outside the
 * `$layers` list below, so this test is unaffected.
 */
test('technical layers are never nested under a domain module (ADR-0017 Law 1)', function (): void {
    $src = __DIR__.'/../../src';
    $layers = ['Actions', 'Models', 'Repositories', 'Enums', 'Events', 'Data', 'Contracts', 'Http'];
    $offenders = [];

    // SELF_FIRST so DIRECTORIES are yielded (the default LEAVES_ONLY mode only
    // yields files, which would make this dir-structure check an inert no-op).
    /** @var Iterator<SplFileInfo> $dirs */
    $dirs = new RecursiveIteratorIterator(
        new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($src, FilesystemIterator::SKIP_DOTS),
        RecursiveIteratorIterator::SELF_FIRST,
    );

    foreach ($dirs as $dir) {
        if (!$dir->isDir()) {
            continue;
        }

        $relative = str_replace($src.'/', '', $dir->getPathname());
        $segments = explode('/', $relative);

        foreach ($segments as $index => $segment) {
            if ($index > 0 && in_array($segment, $layers, true)) {
                $offenders[] = $relative;
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    expect(array_values(array_unique($offenders)))->toBe([]);
});

availableCommands.name: google-workspace
availableCommands.description: Read this before the first Google Drive, Docs, Sheets or Slides connector call whenever the task creates or changes a Google file. Use this skill whenever the user wants to create or change a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides file in their Google Drive. Triggers include: a request that names Google Docs, Sheets, Slides or Drive and asks to make, edit, format, copy or rename a file; a docs.google.com link with a request to change that file, even a one-line fix or suggested edits; and any follow-up change to a Google file from earlier in the chat, even "change it" or "add a tab". Includes helper scripts for document positions, cell ranges and slide layout. However, if the user asks for a doc, deck or spreadsheet without naming Google, or gives a Google file only as source material for something new, use Claude's own output type instead. Do NOT use for read-only questions about a Google file, or for Word, Excel, PowerPoint or PDF files.

availableCommands.description: Read this before the first Google Drive, Docs, Sheets or Slides connector call whenever the task creates or changes a Google file. Use this skill whenever the user wants to create or change a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides file in their Google Drive. However, if the user asks for a doc, deck or spreadsheet without naming Google, or gives a Google file only as source material for something new, use Claude's own output type instead. namespace Vaulter\Drive\Exceptions\Nodes;

use Vaulter\Exceptions\Contracts\ProblemException;
use Vaulter\Exceptions\VaulterException;

/**
 * A move/copy targeted a parent in a DIFFERENT storage tree (§2.2 — drive_id
 * is the tree boundary). A single parent_id UPDATE cannot cross storages without
 * re-homing the whole subtree, so the operation is rejected explicitly rather
 * than corrupting the tree.
 */
final class CrossDriveOperationException extends VaulterException implements ProblemException
{
    private const string PROBLEM_CODE = 'cross_drive_operation';

    private const int HTTP_STATUS = 409;

    public static function between(int|string $fromStorageId, int|string $toStorageId): self
    {
        return new self(
            "[Vaulter] Cannot move a node from storage [{$fromStorageId}] into storage [{$toStorageId}]. ".
            'Fix: a move stays within one storage tree — copy across storages or re-home explicitly instead. '.
            'Docs: '.self::docs('cross-storage-move'),
        );
    }

    public function problemCode(): string
    {
        return self::PROBLEM_CODE;
    }

    public function httpStatus(): int
    {
        return self::HTTP_STATUS;
    }
}

namespace Vaulter\Drive\Exceptions\Nodes;

use Vaulter\Exceptions\Contracts\ProblemException;
use Vaulter\Exceptions\VaulterException;

/**
 * A move would place a node inside itself or one of its own descendants (§2.13 /
 * H.4 cycle guard), which would orphan a cycle out of the adjacency tree. The
 * guard checks the destination against the moved node's subtree before the single
 * parent_id UPDATE.
 */
final class NodeCycleException extends VaulterException implements ProblemException
{
    private const string PROBLEM_CODE = 'node_move_cycle';

    private const int HTTP_STATUS = 409;

    public static function forMove(int|string $nodeId, int|string $intoId): self
    {
        return new self(
            "[Vaulter] Cannot move node [{$nodeId}] into [{$intoId}] — the destination is the node itself or one of ".
            'its descendants, which would create a cycle. '.
            'Fix: choose a destination outside the moved node\'s own subtree. '.
            'Docs: '.self::docs('move-cycle'),
        );
    }

    public function problemCode(): string
    {
        return self::PROBLEM_CODE;
    }

    public function httpStatus(): int
    {
        return self::HTTP_STATUS;
    }
}

namespace Vaulter\Drive\Http\Controllers\Drives;

use Illuminate\Contracts\Auth\Access\Authorizable;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Vaulter\Access\AccessResolver;
use Vaulter\Drive\Http\Resources\DriveResource;
use Vaulter\Enums\Access\Ability;
use Vaulter\Exceptions\Access\PermissionDeniedException;
use Vaulter\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use Vaulter\Models\Drive\Drive;
use Vaulter\Models\Drive\Node;
use Vaulter\Repositories\Drive\NodeReadRepository;

/**
 * Read surface for a storage container (§2.1): its meta, the root node the client
 * opens into, and the used/quota accounting. Thin — the storage arrives
 * route-model resolved (swappable model bound in the provider); the Resource
 * shapes the response.
 *
 * Authorization (M2a / H.2): a storage's "view" maps to View on its ROOT node, so
 * show() guards Ability::View on the storage root through the AccessResolver before
 * returning the meta (mirroring NodeController's per-ACTION guarding); a denial 403s
 * via PermissionDeniedException. The root is resolved READ-ONLY (the BelongsTo on
 * root_node_id, never the provisioning StorageManager — a read endpoint must never
 * write), exactly as StorageResource resolves it for its ability flags.
 */
final class ShowDriveController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly AccessResolver $access,
        private readonly NodeReadRepository $nodes,
    ) {}

    /**
     * Guard View on the storage root before exposing the meta. Edge cases (matched to
     * NodeController's semantics):
     *
     *   - No root node (root_node_id null / the row missing): a storage is ALWAYS
     *     provisioned with its root folder in one transaction (StorageManager::provision),
     *     so a missing root is a corrupt/transient state with no node to authorize against.
     *     It 404s for EVERYONE — never leaking the meta (name, owner, quota) to a grantless
     *     actor — matching the package's deny-on-missing-root convention (ActivityController
     *     "a miss is a corrupt state and 404s" / DocumentNodeController::driveRoot abort(404)).
     *   - Null actor (unauthenticated): denied on a rooted storage — no actor ⇒ no grant
     *     ⇒ 403 (exactly NodeController::guard); on a rootless storage the 404 above fires
     *     first, so the meta never reaches an actor-less caller either way.
     *   - Open drivers (gate/spatie/azgard/null): $access->can delegates to the active
     *     host-role driver, so an open driver decides exactly as it does for the node
     *     listings — the database driver is never hard-coded here.
     */
    public function __invoke(Request $request, Drive $storage): DriveResource
    {
        $root = $this->root($storage);

        if (!$root instanceof Node) {
            // No root folder to gate View on. Provisioning is transactional (the root is
            // born with the storage), so this is a corrupt/transient row, not a viewable
            // "unrooted shell": 404 for everyone rather than serving the meta ungated.
            abort(404);
        }

        $this->guard($request, Ability::View, $root);

        return DriveResource::make($storage);
    }

    /**
     * The storage root node, resolved READ-ONLY through the read repository (never the
     * provisioning StorageManager — a read endpoint must not write). Null when the
     * storage has no root_node_id yet, or the row is missing — matching how
     * StorageResource resolves the root for its ability flags.
     */
    private function root(Drive $storage): ?Node
    {
        if ($storage->root_node_id === null) {
            return null;
        }

        return $this->nodes->find($storage->root_node_id);
    }

    /**
     * Authorize an ability on a node through the AccessResolver (H.2), throwing a
     * 403 PermissionDeniedException when denied. An unauthenticated request is also
     * denied (no actor ⇒ no grant). Mirrors NodeController::guard.
     */
    private function guard(Request $request, Ability $ability, Node $node): void
    {
        $actor = $this->authorizable($request);

        if ($actor === null || !$this->access->can($actor, $ability, $node)) {
            throw PermissionDeniedException::forAbility($ability->value);
        }
    }

    /**
     * The acting authorizable for the request, or null when unauthenticated.
     */
    private function authorizable(Request $request): ?Authorizable
    {
        $user = $request->user();

        return $user instanceof Authorizable ? $user : null;
    }
}

/**
 * The vaulter-drive half of the append-only activity feed (§2.9 / M2c-activity, P2 #5):
 * maps the Drive file/folder/upload domain events to the core {@see ActivityRecorder}
 * public seam, writing EXACTLY ONE row per event (recipients resolved at READ — no
 * fan-out, §1.5). The kernel (Access/Sharing) events are mapped by core's own
 * RecordsActivity; splitting the subscriber by owning package is what lets core stop
 * referencing Vaulter\Drive\Events\* while the feed contract stays identical.
 *
 * Registered by VaulterDriveServiceProvider ONLY when the 'activity' feature is on.
 * RESILIENCE: every handler is wrapped so a recorder failure is logged and swallowed —
 * the Drive events are ShouldDispatchAfterCommit, so the originating action already
 * committed and a missed row is a logged degradation, never a rollback.
 */
final readonly class RecordsDriveActivity
{
    public function __construct(
        private ActivityRecorder $recorder,
    ) {}

    public function subscribe(Dispatcher $events): void
    {
        $events->listen(DriveCreated::class, [self::class, 'handleStorageCreated']);
        $events->listen(FolderCreated::class, [self::class, 'handleNodeCreated']);
        $events->listen(FileUploaded::class, [self::class, 'handleFileUploaded']);
        $events->listen(FileRevisionAdded::class, [self::class, 'handleVersionCommitted']);
        $events->listen(NodeMoved::class, [self::class, 'handleNodeMoved']);
        $events->listen(NodeRenamed::class, [self::class, 'handleNodeRenamed']);
        $events->listen(NodeCopied::class, [self::class, 'handleNodeCopied']);
        $events->listen(NodeTrashed::class, [self::class, 'handleNodeTrashed']);
        $events->listen(NodeRestored::class, [self::class, 'handleNodeRestored']);
        $events->listen(NodePurged::class, [self::class, 'handleNodeForceDeleted']);
        $events->listen(UploadInitiated::class, [self::class, 'handleUploadSessionInitiated']);
        $events->listen(UploadAborted::class, [self::class, 'handleUploadSessionAborted']);
        $events->listen(UploadExpired::class, [self::class, 'handleUploadSessionExpired']);
    }

    public function handleStorageCreated(DriveCreated $event): void
    {
        $this->safely(fn (): mixed => $this->recorder->record(
            verb: EventType::DriveCreated,
            storageId: Identity::key($event->storage->getKey()),
            tenantId: $event->storage->tenant_id,
            actorId: $event->actorId,
            target: $event->root,
            context: [
                'drive_id' => Identity::stringify($event->storage->getKey()),
                'owner_type' => $event->storage->owner_type,
                'owner_id' => Identity::stringify($event->storage->owner_id),
                'name' => $event->storage->name,
            ],
        ), DriveCreated::class);
    }

    public function handleNodeCreated(FolderCreated $event): void
    {
        $this->safely(fn (): mixed => $this->recorder->recordForNode(
            verb: EventType::FolderCreated,
            node: $event->node,
            actorId: $event->actorId,
            context: [
                'kind' => $event->node->kind->value,
                'name' => $event->node->name,
                'parent_id' => Identity::stringify($event->node->parent_id),
            ],
        ), FolderCreated::class);
    }

    public function handleFileUploaded(FileUploaded $event): void
    {
        $this->safely(fn (): mixed => $this->recorder->recordForNode(
            verb: EventType::FileUploaded,
            node: $event->node,
            actorId: $event->actorId,
            context: [
                'name' => $event->node->name,
                'size_bytes' => $event->version->size_bytes,
                'mime_type' => $event->version->mime_type,
                'version_id' => Identity::stringify($event->version->getKey()),
            ],
        ), FileUploaded::class);
    }

    public function handleVersionCommitted(FileRevisionAdded $event): void
    {
        $this->safely(fn (): mixed => $this->recorder->recordForNode(
            verb: EventType::FileRevisionAdded,
            node: $event->node,
            actorId: $event->actorId,
            context: [
                'number' => $event->versionNo,
                'version_id' => Identity::stringify($event->version->getKey()),
                'size_bytes' => $event->version->size_bytes,
            ],
        ), FileRevisionAdded::class);

1→# Changelog

All notable changes to **Vaulter** will be documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/),
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [Unreleased]

10→### Changed

- Drive classes use canonical names and domain namespaces; DriveHandle exposes
  `model(): Drive` and `profile(): Profile` through its core interface, and the
  provider delegates to tested registrars (AD03, AD04). Unused WorkspaceRef and
  BulkAction removed; see UPGRADE.md for the FQN migration map.

- Canonical 0.3 schema and upgrade migrations №1, №2, №4, №8, №9: drives,
  file revisions, ordinary grant uniqueness, event and subscription conversion;
  fresh tables are independent of runtime features (P2.7; see UPGRADE.md).
20→
- Canonical core API: Storage → Drive, FileVersion → FileRevision, Panels → Profiles,
  HostRoleDriver/PermissionResolver → PermissionDriver, Engines → Handlers; no PHP aliases
  (AD03, AD04; see UPGRADE.md for the complete FQN map).
- File handlers use vendor/name `key()` and `viewer()`; viewer descriptors expose key/props,
  and `NodePresenter::present()` replaces `describe()` (AD14).
- Activity and webhook enums merged into EventType with canonical 0.3 values;
  webhook subscriptions exclude upload lifecycle events (AD03, AD04).
- Core provider delegates to five registrars; own-tables profile API and hooks, including
  the previously invoked booted(), removed. Profile scaffolding is vaulter:make:profile
30→  (AD05, AD11). Configuration key normalization follows in P2.5.


### Added
- `BlobStore::commitStaged()` for quota-first uploads and reusable staging across SQL retries (AD21).
- Lossless `BlobScope`, `scope_key`, upgrade migration №7 and resumable
  `vaulter:blobs:repair-scopes --dry-run|--execute` (AD20).
- Batch ACL evaluation (`AccessResolver::evaluateMany`, `AclFolder`), `NodePage`,
  `ExactListing`, signed query-bound cursors and `listing.scan_budget` (AD12).
- Independent `ids.host_keys` configuration (default `varchar(64)`), `HostKeyColumns`
40→  and `VaulterSchema::hostKey()` for host-owned keys (N02, AD25).
- `InvalidDestinationException` (409 `invalid_destination`), `NodeNotTrashedException`
  (409 `node_not_trashed`), `InvalidNodeNameException` (422 `validation_failed`) and
  `Vaulter\Support\NodeName::normalize()` for tree and name invariants (AD13).
- `VaulterDatabase::lockTreeShared()`: the shared mode of the drive tree lock, taken by
  creates, uploads, copies and renames (AD13, D21).

### Changed
- CAS commit and content-key contracts take `BlobScope`; UUID/ULID scopes use
  NULL-free uniqueness and the same `cas:{scope_key}:{sha256}` lock in commit, GC
50→  and reconcile. Existing blob paths and disks remain authoritative (AD20).
- Children, search, trash, shared, folder children and Filament now display only nodes
  with effective View for every driver. Shared uses cursors instead of page/total;
  REST listings omit totals and reuse batch ACL results for abilities (AD12).
- `vaulter-documents` and `vaulter-filament` require `vaulter-drive` at runtime (AD02).
- HTTP routes use separate `routes.middleware.authenticated`, `public` and `hub`
  stacks; protected routes default to `auth:sanctum`. Legacy `middleware` overrides
  only the authenticated stack, and metrics are appended to all stacks (AD31).
- Domain events carry a readonly `eventId` ULID with an optional final constructor
  argument for replay. Webhook `event_id` now identifies an event occurrence rather
60→  than its resulting state; retries retain the same id (AD22).
- Domain HTTP errors include a stable `code` through `ProblemException` (AD29).
  Name conflicts now return 409 `node_name_conflict` (previously 422); assembled
  upload MIME mismatches return 422 `upload_rejected` with `reason: mime_mismatch`
  (previously 415). Existing validation fields and tus headers are preserved.
- `vaulter-azgard` now follows the public AzGuard 0.3 line and its widened
  `BackedEnum` panel/role contracts; CI checks out the latest public AzGuard commit
  directly from GitHub without a private repository token.

### Fixed
70→- Atomic storage quota reservations for uploads and subtree copies (E2, AD21),
  fresh head-size deltas, file revision counters under `FOR UPDATE`, canonical
  drive/node/file/quota/CAS lock order and three-attempt transaction retries.
- A node created with no parent (notably documents) is placed under the drive root
  instead of becoming a hidden second root; upgrade migration №6 moves existing second
  roots under their root (renaming clashes ` (legacy N)`, logged as `node.moved`) and
  adds a unique one-root-per-drive index. The repair is irreversible (N04, AD13).
- Create, upload, move, copy and restore only target live folders of the same drive,
  checked under row locks; the root can no longer be renamed, moved, copied, trashed
  or deleted; moves take the drive tree lock so concurrent moves cannot form a cycle;
80→  `forceDelete` only purges trashed nodes and node names are normalized (N05, AD13).
- Host owner, subject, author, tenant and actor columns now use `ids.host_keys`
  instead of Vaulter's entity-ID strategy. Upgrade migration №3 preserves existing
  values and restores the strategy's types on rollback (N02, AD25).
- Repository metadata, exception documentation, collaboration errors and install
  star prompt now point to `axiomasoft/vaulter`; package vendor names stay
  `axioma-studio/vaulter-*` (N20/E6, AD02).
- Filament Move filters destinations and checks workspace creation and destination
  Create access at action time, notifying the actor on denial (N14).
- Vaulter resource resolution no longer registers global `node`/`storage` bindings
90→  that interfere with host routes. Missing resources return their 404 problem code (N10, AD31).
- Outbox deduplication no longer loses repeated rename or trash/restore operations
  returning to the same state; only a replay of the same event id is deduplicated (E8).
- All domain exceptions now return their documented 4xx status instead of HTTP 500
  on JSON requests and Vaulter routes (N11, AD29); configuration and infrastructure
  errors retain Laravel's default handling.
- Vaulter transactions, CAS/tree locks, raw queries and after-commit callbacks now use
  `vaulter.connection` through the new `Vaulter\Database\VaulterDatabase` singleton,
  preserving atomicity when the host default connection differs (N01, AD25).
  UploadSession, UploadPart, NodeComment and NodeDocumentVersion also resolve that
100→  connection so their writes cannot autocommit outside those transactions.
- Release workflows now keep the root npm lockfile, test the npm workspace before
  publishing, pass the PHP split token through the action's supported environment,
  reject tags whose exact SHA lacks the ordinary CI checks, and publish the GHCR
  image under the source repository owner.

| №1 `2026_10_01_000001_vaulter_preflight` | Read-only safety checks before any rename. |
| №2 `…000002_rename_storages_to_drives` | Normalize legacy table overrides, rename `storages` to `drives`, `panel` to `profile` and `storage_id` to `drive_id`; create missing core tables. |
| №4 `…000004_file_revisions` | `file_versions` / `file_version_blobs` become `file_revisions` / `file_revision_blobs`; `version_no` → `number`, `content_sha256` → `sha256`, `file_version_id` → `file_revision_id`. File handles use `current_revision_id` / `revision_count`. Upload sessions use `target_node_id` and nullable result references. |
| №8 `…000008_grants_shares_cleanup` | Hard-delete soft-deleted grants; preserve share revocation as `COALESCE(revoked_at, deleted_at)`; remove deleted/inherited columns and use an ordinary grant UNIQUE. |
| №9 `…000009_events` | Convert activity/outbox/delivery events and endpoint subscription lists; add activity occurrence ID and nullable outbox aggregate columns. |

`Config::table()` now always returns prefix + canonical entity name. Old
`vaulter.table_names` is read only by `Config::legacyTable()` during upgrade.
Drive/File/NodeGrant/NodeShare models no longer use Eloquent `SoftDeletes`.
`Profile::storageType()` and `storageTypeKey()` are removed. HTTP JSON keys such as
`storage_id`, `version_no`, `content_sha256` and `panel` stay unchanged until P6.1;
removed drive metadata `slug` and `storage_type` return null.

Rollback restores historical names, structure and event values, but cannot recover
hard-deleted grants, deleted drive metadata (`slug`, `storage_type`,
`default_node_permissions`), or the original grant inheritance fields. Reintroduced
columns use defaults (`storage_type=private`, permissions=31, inherited=false,
nullable fields=null). Share revocation and №6 tree repairs remain in effect. Tables
created for previously disabled features remain. Roll back the full upgrade batch to
reach migration №2: `--step=5` only reaches №4 when all eight upgrade migrations run.
Fresh-install rollback leaves canonical names for the base migrations to drop.

Webhook consumers must update these event names. Subscription conversion preserves
order, duplicates, wildcards and third-party names:

However, if the user asks for a doc, deck or spreadsheet without naming Google, or gives a Google file only as source material for something new, use Claude's own output type instead. use Vaulter\Schema\VaulterSchema;
use Vaulter\Support\Config;
use Vaulter\ValueObjects\Cas\BlobScope;

/**
 * VLT-REL P2.2 — executable freeze of the public composer surface for the `0.1.0`
 * tag. The human-readable SSOT is `plans/archive/VLT-REL/root/contracts/public-api-surface.md`
 * (P2.1); THIS test is its enforceable counterpart: it reflects the LIVE signatures of
 * every `Vaulter\Contracts\**` interface plus the `Vaulter\Facades\Vaulter` facade,
 * canonicalises them into a stable manifest, and compares against a committed golden.
 * Any unplanned change to the surface (a removed/renamed method, a narrowed parameter
 * type, a new contract, a dropped facade `@method`) reddens the build.
 *
 * WHY reflection, not the doc: the doc can drift silently; this test can't — the golden
 * is generated from real signatures, so a `public-api.md:19` breaking change (removal /
 * rename / type narrowing) is caught mechanically, not by review vigilance.
 *
 * Canonicalisation (D5 — signatures only; config/resources/bindings live in the doc):
 *   • Contracts are DISCOVERED by scanning `src/Contracts/**` — so a NEW contract is
 *     frozen automatically (its absence from the golden reddens the build), not just the
 *     ones enumerated today.
 *   • Full signature: parameter name + type (union/intersection/nullable normalised),
 *     by-ref, variadic, default value; return type. Named-argument discipline
 *     (`php:named-arguments`) makes parameter NAMES part of the contract, so they are
 *     frozen too.
 *   • `@internal`-marked interfaces/methods are EXCLUDED (outside the BC promise,
 *     `public-api.md:22`).
 *   • Deterministic order: contracts sorted by FQCN, methods sorted by name, union/
 *     intersection members sorted — so a harmless reorder never reddens the build while
 *     a real signature diff reads cleanly.
 *   • The facade is frozen by its `@method` docblock (it stands over the resolved
 *     `VaulterManager`, Laravel Manager idiom — SSOT §2), not by reflecting the thin
 *     Facade class (whose only real method is the protected accessor).
 *
 * AMEND (adding surface legally after the tag): regenerate the golden with
 * `UPDATE_SNAPSHOT=1`, add a new `D#`, sync `plan.md` §7 Contracts, and ship a CHANGELOG
 * MINOR — see `plans/archive/VLT-REL/root/contracts/AMEND.md`. Regenerating the golden OUTSIDE
 * that procedure (no `D#`) is a `[POSSIBLE-DEFECT]` per `.claude/rules/tests.md`.
 * `UPDATE_SNAPSHOT` is env-gated and is NEVER set by any CI workflow.
 */
if (!function_exists('vaulterSnapshotType')) {
    /**
     * Normalise a reflection type to a canonical, deterministic string. Union and
     * intersection members are sorted so a source-level reorder (not a BC change) does
     * not redden the build. Non-builtin types carry a leading `\` for an unambiguous FQCN.
     */
    function vaulterSnapshotType(?ReflectionType $type): string
    {
        if ($type === null) {
            return '';
        }

        if ($type instanceof ReflectionUnionType) {
            $parts = array_map(vaulterSnapshotType(...), $type->getTypes());
            sort($parts);

            return implode('|', $parts);
        }

        if ($type instanceof ReflectionIntersectionType) {
            $parts = array_map(vaulterSnapshotType(...), $type->getTypes());
            sort($parts);

            return implode('&', $parts);
        }

        /** @var ReflectionNamedType $type */
        $name = $type->getName();
        $lower = strtolower($name);
        $prefix = ($type->allowsNull() && $lower !== 'null' && $lower !== 'mixed') ? '?' : '';

        return $prefix.($type->isBuiltin() ? '' : '\\').$name;
    }
}

if (!function_exists('vaulterSnapshotValue')) {
    /**
     * Compact, deterministic rendering of a parameter default value (scalars, null,
     * shallow arrays — the only shapes contract defaults take).
     */
    function vaulterSnapshotValue(mixed $value): string
    {
        if ($value === null) {
            return 'null';
        }

        if (is_bool($value)) {
            return $value ? 'true' : 'false';
        }

        if (is_string($value)) {
            return "'".$value."'";
        }

        if (is_array($value)) {
            return '['.implode(', ', array_map(vaulterSnapshotValue(...), $value)).']';
        }

        if (is_int($value) || is_float($value)) {
            return (string) $value;
