<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

/**
 * VLT-REL P2.2 — executable freeze of vaulter-drive's public composer surface for the `0.1.0`
 * tag. Counterpart to the P2.1 SSOT (`plans/archive/VLT-REL/root/contracts/public-api-surface.md`):
 * reflects every `Vaulter\\Drive\\Contracts\**` contract into a canonical manifest and compares it to a
 * committed golden, reddening the build on any unplanned signature change (removed/renamed
 * method, narrowed type, a new contract). Same canonicalisation and AMEND procedure as
 * vaulter-core's PublicApiSnapshotTest (D5 — signatures only; config/resources/bindings
 * are frozen by the doc + `.claude/rules/public-api.md`, not reflection). `UPDATE_SNAPSHOT`
 * is env-gated and NEVER set by CI; regenerating outside AMEND (no D#) is `[POSSIBLE-DEFECT]`.
 */
if (!function_exists('vaulterSnapshotType')) {
    /**
     * Normalise a reflection type to a canonical, deterministic string. Union and
     * intersection members are sorted so a source-level reorder (not a BC change) does
     * not redden the build. Non-builtin types carry a leading `\` for an unambiguous FQCN.
     */
    function vaulterSnapshotType(?ReflectionType $type): string
    {
        if ($type === null) {
            return '';
        }

        if ($type instanceof ReflectionUnionType) {
            $parts = array_map('vaulterSnapshotType', $type->getTypes());
            sort($parts);

            return implode('|', $parts);
        }

        if ($type instanceof ReflectionIntersectionType) {
            $parts = array_map('vaulterSnapshotType', $type->getTypes());
            sort($parts);

            return implode('&', $parts);
        }

        /** @var ReflectionNamedType $type */
        $name = $type->getName();
        $lower = strtolower($name);
        $prefix = ($type->allowsNull() && $lower !== 'null' && $lower !== 'mixed') ? '?' : '';

        return $prefix.($type->isBuiltin() ? '' : '\\').$name;
    }
}

if (!function_exists('vaulterSnapshotValue')) {
    /**
     * Compact, deterministic rendering of a parameter default value (scalars, null,
     * shallow arrays — the only shapes contract defaults take).
     */
    function vaulterSnapshotValue(mixed $value): string
    {
        if ($value === null) {
            return 'null';
        }

        if (is_bool($value)) {
            return $value ? 'true' : 'false';
        }

        if (is_string($value)) {
            return "'".$value."'";
        }

        if (is_array($value)) {
            return '['.implode(', ', array_map('vaulterSnapshotValue', $value)).']';
        }

        if (is_int($value) || is_float($value)) {
            return (string) $value;
        }

        return get_debug_type($value);
    }
}

if (!function_exists('vaulterSnapshotMethod')) {
    /** Serialise one public method to `name(type $p = default, …): return`. */
    function vaulterSnapshotMethod(ReflectionMethod $method): string
    {
        $params = [];

        foreach ($method->getParameters() as $param) {
            $piece = vaulterSnapshotType($param->getType());
            $piece .= ' ';
            $piece .= $param->isPassedByReference() ? '&' : '';
            $piece .= $param->isVariadic() ? '...' : '';
            $piece .= '$'.$param->getName();

            if ($param->isDefaultValueAvailable()) {
                $piece .= ' = '.($param->isDefaultValueConstant()
                    ? (string) $param->getDefaultValueConstantName()
                    : vaulterSnapshotValue($param->getDefaultValue()));
            }

            $params[] = trim($piece);
        }

        $return = vaulterSnapshotType($method->getReturnType());

        return $method->getName().'('.implode(', ', $params).')'.($return !== '' ? ': '.$return : '');
    }
}

if (!function_exists('vaulterSnapshotInterface')) {
    /**
     * Serialise one contract: FQCN header + its public, non-`@internal` methods (sorted).
     *
     * @param class-string $fqcn
     */
    function vaulterSnapshotInterface(string $fqcn): string
    {
        $reflection = new ReflectionClass($fqcn);
        $lines = [];

        foreach ($reflection->getMethods(ReflectionMethod::IS_PUBLIC) as $method) {
            $doc = $method->getDocComment();

            if ($doc !== false && str_contains($doc, '@internal')) {
                continue;
            }

            $lines[] = '  '.vaulterSnapshotMethod($method);
        }

        sort($lines);

        return $fqcn."\n".implode("\n", $lines);
    }
}

if (!function_exists('vaulterSnapshotContracts')) {
    /**
     * Discover every `*\Contracts\**` interface under a package src tree and map each
     * file to its FQCN (PSR-4: basename === declared type). `@internal`-marked types are
     * dropped from the frozen set.
     *
     * @return list<class-string> sorted FQCNs
     */
    function vaulterSnapshotContracts(string $contractsDir, string $namespaceRoot): array
    {
        if (!is_dir($contractsDir)) {
            return [];
        }

        /** @var Iterator<SplFileInfo> $files */
        $files = new RegexIterator(
            new RecursiveIteratorIterator(new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($contractsDir, FilesystemIterator::SKIP_DOTS)),
            '/\.php$/',
        );

        $fqcns = [];

        foreach ($files as $file) {
            $relative = substr(str_replace($contractsDir.'/', '', $file->getPathname()), 0, -4);
            $fqcn = $namespaceRoot.'\\'.str_replace('/', '\\', $relative);

            // Per-branch interface_exists()/class_exists() narrow $fqcn to class-string
            // (an OR of the two does not), so ReflectionClass type-checks without a
            // suppression. Contracts are interfaces by invariant (arch 'contracts are
            // interfaces'); the class branch keeps discovery honest if that ever slips.
            if (interface_exists($fqcn)) {
                $reflection = new ReflectionClass($fqcn);
            } elseif (class_exists($fqcn)) {
                $reflection = new ReflectionClass($fqcn);
            } else {
                continue;
            }

            $doc = $reflection->getDocComment();

            if ($doc !== false && str_contains($doc, '@internal')) {
                continue;
            }

            $fqcns[] = $fqcn;

namespace Vaulter\Drive;

use Illuminate\Contracts\Container\Container;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Vaulter\Contracts\Drive\DriveHandle as DriveHandleContract;
use Vaulter\Contracts\Drive\DriveHandleFactory as DriveHandleFactoryContract;
use Vaulter\Drive\Actions\Files\IngestFileAction;
use Vaulter\Drive\Actions\Nodes\CopyNodeAction;
use Vaulter\Drive\Actions\Nodes\CreateFolderAction;
use Vaulter\Drive\Actions\Nodes\MoveNodeAction;
use Vaulter\Drive\Actions\Nodes\RenameNodeAction;
use Vaulter\Drive\Actions\Trash\PurgeNodeAction;
use Vaulter\Drive\Actions\Trash\RestoreNodeAction;
use Vaulter\Drive\Actions\Trash\TrashNodeAction;
use Vaulter\Models\Drive\Drive;
use Vaulter\Profiles\ProfileRegistry;
use Vaulter\Repositories\Drive\NodeReadRepository;

/**
 * The vaulter-drive implementation of the core {@see DriveHandleFactory} seam
 * (P2 #5 / ADR-0015). It wires the DriveProvisioner, NodeReadRepository and the eight
 * Drive Actions into a {@see DriveHandle}, so `Vaulter::for()` / `Vaulter::forStorage()`
 * (defined in core's VaulterManager) return a working handle without core ever
 * referencing a Drive class. Bound to the contract by VaulterDriveServiceProvider.
 */
final readonly class DriveHandleFactory implements DriveHandleFactoryContract
{
    public function __construct(
        private Container $container,
    ) {}

    public function forOwner(Model $entity, string $panel): DriveHandleContract
    {
        $storage = $this->container->make(DriveProvisioner::class)->forOwner(owner: $entity, panel: $panel);

        return $this->forStorage($storage);
    }

    public function forStorage(Drive $storage): DriveHandleContract
    {
        return new DriveHandle(
            storage: $storage,
            profiles: $this->container->make(ProfileRegistry::class),
            storages: $this->container->make(DriveProvisioner::class),
            nodes: $this->container->make(NodeReadRepository::class),
            createFolder: $this->container->make(CreateFolderAction::class),
            uploadFile: $this->container->make(IngestFileAction::class),
            moveNode: $this->container->make(MoveNodeAction::class),
            renameNode: $this->container->make(RenameNodeAction::class),
            copyNode: $this->container->make(CopyNodeAction::class),
            trashNode: $this->container->make(TrashNodeAction::class),
            restoreNode: $this->container->make(RestoreNodeAction::class),
            forceDeleteNode: $this->container->make(PurgeNodeAction::class),
        );
    }
}

 * Get-or-create a storage container for a host entity within a panel (§2.1), with

 * (owner_type, owner_id, panel) is the idempotency key — guarded by the partial
 * UNIQUE index defineStorages adds, so concurrent first-touches converge on one
 * row (the INSERT loser catches the unique violation and re-reads).
 *
 * The storage's defaults come from the panel: disk from config storage.default_disk
 * and storage_type from the resolved Panel. A fresh storage gets a kind=folder
 * root node, and root_node_id is repointed at it once it exists (the schema leaves
 * that pair without a hard FK to dodge the chicken-and-egg insert order).
 */
final readonly class DriveProvisioner
{
    public function __construct(
        private DriveReadRepository $read,
        private DriveStoreRepository $store,
        private NodeStoreRepository $nodes,
        private VaulterDatabase $database,
    ) {}

    /**
     * Resolve (or provision) the storage mounted on $owner within $panel.
     * Idempotent: a second call returns the same row.
     */
    public function forOwner(Model $owner, string $panel = 'default'): Drive
    {
        $existing = $this->read->forOwner(owner: $owner, panel: $panel);

        if ($existing instanceof Drive) {
            return $existing;
        }

        try {
            return $this->provision(owner: $owner, panel: $panel);
        } catch (UniqueConstraintViolationException) {
            // Lost the create race — the (owner_type, owner_id, panel) unique index
            // is the backbone; re-read the winner.
            $winner = $this->read->forOwner(owner: $owner, panel: $panel);

            if ($winner instanceof Drive) {
                return $winner;
            }

            throw new \RuntimeException(
                'Lost the storage provisioning race but the winning row is not visible.',
            );
        }
    }

70→### Broadcast details

All three `NodeComment*` events publish to a `PrivateChannel` named
`{collaboration.channel_prefix}.{nodeId}` (default prefix `vaulter.documents`) — the
same room open editors join for collaboration.

| Event | `broadcastAs()` | `broadcastWith()` keys |
|---|---|---|
| `NodeCommentAdded` | `node-comment.added` | `id`, `node_id`, `parent_id`, `body`, `created_at` |
| `NodeCommentResolved` | `node-comment.resolved` | `id`, `node_id`, `resolved_at`, `resolved_by` |
80→| `NodeCommentDeleted` | `node-comment.deleted` | `id`, `node_id` |

```php
// Echo-side listener (front-end)
Echo.private(`vaulter.documents.${nodeId}`)
    .listen('.node-comment.added', (e) => { /* … */ })
    .listen('.node-comment.resolved', (e) => { /* … */ })
    .listen('.node-comment.deleted', (e) => { /* … */ })
```

90→## Drive — `Vaulter\Drive\Events` (requires `axioma-studio/vaulter-drive`)

All `ShouldDispatchAfterCommit`.

| Event | Constructor payload |
|---|---|
| `StorageCreated` | `Storage $storage, Node $root, int\|string\|null $actorId = null` |
| `NodeCreated` | `Node $node, int\|string\|null $actorId = null` |
| `FileUploaded` | `Node $node, File $file, FileRevision $version, int\|string\|null $actorId = null` |
| `FileRevisionAdded` | `Node $node, File $file, FileRevision $version, int $versionNo, int\|string\|null $actorId = null` |
100→| `NodeRenamed` | `Node $node, string $fromName, string $toName, int\|string\|null $actorId = null` |
| `NodeMoved` | `Node $node, int\|string\|null $fromParentId, int\|string\|null $toParentId, int\|string\|null $actorId = null` |
| `NodeCopied` | `Node $source, Node $copy, int\|string\|null $actorId = null` |
| `NodeTrashed` | `Node $node, int\|string\|null $actorId = null` |
| `NodeRestored` | `Node $node, int\|string\|null $actorId = null` |
| `NodePurged` | `int\|string $storageId, array $nodeIds, int $freedBytes, int\|string\|null $actorId = null` |

- `StorageCreated` — fires when `Vaulter::for()` get-or-creates a `v_storages` row;
  `$root` is the auto-provisioned root folder node.
- `NodePurged` — note this carries **ids**, not models (`$storageId`,
110→  `array $nodeIds`) plus `$freedBytes`; it's emitted after the subtree is gone, so its
  rows no longer exist. Listeners can schedule GC and release quota.

## Sharing — `Vaulter\Events\Sharing`

All `ShouldDispatchAfterCommit`.

| Event | Constructor payload |
|---|---|
| `NodeShareCreated` | `NodeShare $share, int\|string\|null $actorId = null` |

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use Illuminate\Config\Repository;
use Illuminate\Container\Container;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Application;
use Vaulter\Contracts\Cas\StorageDriver;
use Vaulter\Contracts\Drive\DriveHandleFactory as DriveHandleFactoryContract;
use Vaulter\Database\VaulterDatabase;
use Vaulter\Drive\DriveHandleFactory;
use Vaulter\Drive\DriveProvisioner;
use Vaulter\Drive\Models\Uploads\UploadPart;
use Vaulter\Drive\Models\Uploads\UploadSession;
use Vaulter\Drive\Providers\BindingsRegistrar;
use Vaulter\Drive\Uploads\UploadSessionManager;

it('merges upload model defaults without replacing host model overrides', function (): void {
    $app = new Application;
    Container::setInstance($this->app);
    $config = new Repository(['vaulter' => ['models' => [
        'upload_session' => 'Host\\UploadSession',
        'node' => 'Host\\Node',
    ]]]);
    $app->instance('config', $config);

    (new BindingsRegistrar($app))->register();

    expect($config->get('vaulter.models.upload_session'))->toBe('Host\\UploadSession')
        ->and($config->get('vaulter.models.upload_part'))->toBe(UploadPart::class)
        ->and($config->get('vaulter.models.node'))->toBe('Host\\Node');
});

it('registers the factory and preserves singleton service lifetimes in a fresh container', function (): void {
    $app = new Application;
    Container::setInstance($this->app);
    $config = new Repository;
    $app->instance('config', $config);
    $app->instance(VaulterDatabase::class, $this->app->make(VaulterDatabase::class));
    $app->instance(StorageDriver::class, $this->app->make(StorageDriver::class));

    (new BindingsRegistrar($app))->register();

    $factory = $app->make(DriveHandleFactoryContract::class);
    $provisioner = $app->make(DriveProvisioner::class);
    $uploads = $app->make(UploadSessionManager::class);

    expect($factory)->toBeInstanceOf(DriveHandleFactory::class)
        ->and($app->make(DriveHandleFactoryContract::class))->not->toBe($factory)
        ->and($provisioner)->toBeInstanceOf(DriveProvisioner::class)
        ->and($app->make(DriveProvisioner::class))->toBe($provisioner)
        ->and($uploads)->toBeInstanceOf(UploadSessionManager::class)
        ->and($app->make(UploadSessionManager::class))->toBe($uploads)
        ->and($config->get('vaulter.models.upload_session'))->toBe(UploadSession::class)
        ->and($config->get('vaulter.models.upload_part'))->toBe(UploadPart::class);
});

declare(strict_types=1);

use Illuminate\Events\Dispatcher;
use Illuminate\Routing\Router;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Event;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use Spatie\LaravelPackageTools\Package;
use Vaulter\Drive\Activity\RecordsDriveActivity;
use Vaulter\Drive\Console\PurgeTrashCommand;
use Vaulter\Drive\Console\SweepUploadsCommand;
use Vaulter\Drive\Events\Nodes\FolderCreated;
use Vaulter\Drive\Events\Uploads\UploadInitiated;
use Vaulter\Drive\Http\Controllers\Drives\ShowDriveController;
use Vaulter\Drive\Http\Controllers\Uploads\S3MultipartProtocolController;
use Vaulter\Drive\Http\Controllers\Uploads\TusProtocolController;
use Vaulter\Drive\Providers\HttpRegistrar;
use Vaulter\Drive\Webhooks\RecordsDriveOutbox;
use Vaulter\Http\Middleware\ResolveVaulterRouteParameters;

it('registers each subscriber only when its own feature is enabled', function (bool $activity, bool $reliability): void {
    config()->set('vaulter.features.activity', $activity);
    config()->set('vaulter.features.reliability', $reliability);
    $original = Event::getFacadeRoot();
    $events = new Dispatcher($this->app);
    Event::swap($events);

    try {
        (new HttpRegistrar)->boot($this->app);

        $listeners = [];

        if ($activity) {
            $listeners[] = [RecordsDriveActivity::class, 'handleNodeCreated'];
        }

        if ($reliability) {
            $listeners[] = [RecordsDriveOutbox::class, 'handleNodeCreated'];
        }

        expect($events->getRawListeners()[FolderCreated::class] ?? [])->toBe($listeners)
            ->and($events->getRawListeners()[UploadInitiated::class] ?? [])->toBe(
                $activity ? [[RecordsDriveActivity::class, 'handleUploadSessionInitiated']] : [],
            );
    } finally {
        Event::swap($original);
    }
})->with([
    'both disabled' => [false, false],
    'activity only' => [true, false],
    'reliability only' => [false, true],
    'both enabled' => [true, true],
]);

it('declares the existing routes and commands and preserves route feature gates', function (bool $uploads, bool $grants): void {
    config()->set('vaulter.route_prefix', 'host/drive');
    config()->set('vaulter.middleware', ['host.auth']);
    config()->set('vaulter.features.uploads', $uploads);
    config()->set('vaulter.features.grants', $grants);
    $package = new Package;
    (new HttpRegistrar)->configure($package);

    expect($package->routeFileNames)->toBe(['drive'])
        ->and($package->commands)->toBe([PurgeTrashCommand::class, SweepUploadsCommand::class]);

    $original = Route::getFacadeRoot();
    $router = new Router(new Dispatcher($this->app), $this->app);
    Route::swap($router);

    try {
        foreach ($package->routeFileNames as $file) {
            require __DIR__.'/../../routes/'.$file.'.php';
        }

        $routes = collect($router->getRoutes()->getRoutes());
        $show = $routes->first(fn ($route): bool => $route->uri() === 'host/drive/storages/{storage}');

        expect($show)->not->toBeNull()
            ->and($show->getAction('uses'))->toBe(ShowDriveController::class.'@__invoke')
            ->and($show->getControllerClass())->toBe(ShowDriveController::class)
            ->and($show->methods())->toBe(['GET', 'HEAD'])
            ->and($show->middleware())->toContain('host.auth', ResolveVaulterRouteParameters::class)
            ->and($show->getName())->toBeNull()
            ->and($routes->contains(fn ($route): bool => $route->uri() === 'host/drive/shared'))->toBe($grants);

        $tus = $routes->first(fn ($route): bool => $route->uri() === 'host/drive/storages/{storage}/resumable-uploads');
        $multipart = $routes->first(fn ($route): bool => $route->uri() === 'host/drive/resumable-uploads/{upload_id}/complete');

        if (!$uploads) {
            expect($tus)->toBeNull()->and($multipart)->toBeNull();

            return;
        }

        expect($tus)->not->toBeNull()
            ->and($tus->getActionName())->toBe(TusProtocolController::class.'@create')
            ->and($tus->middleware())->toContain('host.auth', 'throttle:vaulter-uploads')
            ->and($multipart)->not->toBeNull()
            ->and($multipart->getActionName())->toBe(S3MultipartProtocolController::class.'@complete');

`DownloadController`). Storage-collection endpoints carry `{storage}` in the path;
node-scoped endpoints derive the storage from the bound `{node}`.

content.text:
70→  a missing destination always resolves to the root.
- **Destinations are live folders of the same drive.** Creating, uploading, moving or
  copying into a file, a document or a trashed folder raises
  `InvalidDestinationException` (409 `invalid_destination`); a folder of another drive
  raises `CrossDriveOperationException` (409 `cross_drive_operation`).
- **The root is never an operand.** Renaming, moving, copying, trashing or
  force-deleting it raises `InvalidDestinationException`.
- **No cycles.** A folder cannot move into itself or its own subtree
  (`CycleException`, 409 `node_move_cycle`), even when two moves race.

80→Every write takes the drive's tree lock first — exclusively for move, restore, trash and
force-delete, shared for create, upload, copy and rename — and only then locks node rows.
On PostgreSQL uploads into one drive stay concurrent; a structural operation waits for
them. A custom Action that changes the tree should follow the same order
(`VaulterDatabase::lockTree()` / `lockTreeShared()`, then node rows).

```php
$root = $drive->root();          // Vaulter\Models\Drive\Node
$storage = $drive->model();    // Vaulter\Models\Drive\Drive
$panel = $drive->profile();        // string
90→```

The storage tracks `used_bytes` and an optional `quota_bytes` (nullable = no
quota). Both are integer-cast on the model and surfaced verbatim by the
[`StorageResource`](/reference/rest-api#storages) so the UI can render a usage bar:

```php
$storage = $drive->model();
100→
$storage->used_bytes;   // int — bytes currently consumed
$storage->quota_bytes;  // ?int — null means unlimited
```

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\Profiles;

/** A named policy for drives sharing the configured Vaulter schema. */
final class Profile
{
    /** @param array<string, bool> $features */
    public function __construct(
        private string $id = '',
        private ?string $hostModel = null,
        private bool $hasGrants = true,
        private array $features = [],
    ) {}

    public function id(string $id): self
    {
        $this->id = $id;

        return $this;
    }

    public function host(string $model): self
    {
        $this->hostModel = $model;

        return $this;
    }

    public function grants(): self
    {
        $this->hasGrants = true;

        return $this;
    }

    public function withoutGrants(): self
    {
        $this->hasGrants = false;

        return $this;
    }

    /** @param array<string, bool> $flags */
    public function features(array $flags): self
    {
        $this->features = [...$this->features, ...$flags];

        return $this;
    }

    public function feature(string $name, bool $on = true): self
    {
        $this->features[$name] = $on;

        return $this;
    }

    public function getId(): string
    {
        return $this->id;
    }

    public function hostModel(): ?string
    {
        return $this->hostModel;
    }

    public function hasGrants(): bool
    {
        return $this->hasGrants;
    }

    public function featureEnabled(string $name): bool
    {
        if (array_key_exists($name, $this->features)) {
            return $this->features[$name];

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Vaulter\Drive\Http\Resources;

use Illuminate\Contracts\Auth\Access\Authorizable;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Http\Resources\Json\JsonResource;
use Vaulter\Access\AccessResolver;
use Vaulter\Enums\Access\Ability;
use Vaulter\Models\Drive\Drive;
use Vaulter\Models\Drive\Node;
use Vaulter\Repositories\Drive\NodeReadRepository;

/**
 * The read shape of a storage container (§2.1): its meta, the root node the
 * client opens into, and the used/quota accounting the UI shows as a usage bar.
 * Read-only — it transforms an already-loaded Storage, never WRITES (it resolves the
 * root node through the read repository, never the provisioning StorageManager).
 *
 * @mixin Drive
 */
final class DriveResource extends JsonResource
{
    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    #[\Override]
    public function toArray(Request $request): array
    {
        /** @var Drive $storage */
        $storage = $this->resource;

        return [
            'id' => $storage->getKey(),
            'panel' => $storage->profile,
            'owner' => [
                'type' => $storage->owner_type,
                'id' => $storage->owner_id,
            ],
            'name' => $storage->name,
            'slug' => null,
            'root_node_id' => $storage->root_node_id,
            'disk' => $storage->disk,
            'storage_type' => null,
            'used_bytes' => $storage->used_bytes,
            'quota_bytes' => $storage->quota_bytes,
            'status' => $storage->status,
            'created_at' => $storage->created_at,
            'updated_at' => $storage->updated_at,
            // What the request actor may do on the storage ROOT (§2.6 / H.2),
            // resolved through the AccessResolver so the Vue client gates its
            // toolbar (open the storage, create folders, upload, manage).
            'abilities' => $this->abilities($request, $storage),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * The storage-root ability flags the Vue toolbar binds against, resolved through
     * the AccessResolver for the request's actor (§2.6 / H.2). Mapped to the four
     * frontend keys: view (View on root), create_folder + upload (Create on root,
     * AND the workspace-create gate), manage (Manage on root).
     *
     * Resilience: with no acting user OR no provisioned root node yet, every flag is
     * false — a read-only shell (the SAFE default; the toolbar advertises nothing it
     * cannot back). The Resource never WRITES, so a missing root is resolved as
     * "nothing yet", never auto-provisioned here.
     *
     * @return array<string, bool>
     */
    private function abilities(Request $request, Drive $storage): array
    {
        $actor = $this->actor($request);
        $root = $this->root($storage);

        if ($actor === null || !$root instanceof Node) {
            return [
                'view' => false,
                'create_folder' => false,
                'upload' => false,
                'manage' => false,
            ];
        }

        $resolver = app(AccessResolver::class);
        $flags = $resolver->abilitiesFor($actor, $root);

        $canCreate = ($flags[Ability::Create->value] ?? false)
            && $resolver->canCreateInWorkspace($actor, $storage);

        return [
            'view' => $flags[Ability::View->value] ?? false,
            'create_folder' => $canCreate,
            'upload' => $canCreate,
            'manage' => $flags[Ability::Manage->value] ?? false,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * The storage root node, resolved READ-ONLY through the read repository (never the
     * provisioning StorageManager — a Resource must not write). Null when the storage
     * has no root_node_id yet, or the row is missing.
     */
    private function root(Drive $storage): ?Node
    {
        if ($storage->root_node_id === null) {
            return null;
        }

        return app(NodeReadRepository::class)->find($storage->root_node_id);
    }

    /**
     * The acting authorizable for the request, or null when unauthenticated.
     */
    private function actor(Request $request): ?Authorizable
    {
        $user = $request->user();

        return $user instanceof Authorizable ? $user : null;
    }
}

availableCommands.name: google-workspace
availableCommands.description: Read this before the first Google Drive, Docs, Sheets or Slides connector call whenever the task creates or changes a Google file. Use this skill whenever the user wants to create or change a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides file in their Google Drive. Triggers include: a request that names Google Docs, Sheets, Slides or Drive and asks to make, edit, format, copy or rename a file; a docs.google.com link with a request to change that file, even a one-line fix or suggested edits; and any follow-up change to a Google file from earlier in the chat, even "change it" or "add a tab". Includes helper scripts for document positions, cell ranges and slide layout. However, if the user asks for a doc, deck or spreadsheet without naming Google, or gives a Google file only as source material for something new, use Claude's own output type instead. Do NOT use for read-only questions about a Google file, or for Word, Excel, PowerPoint or PDF files.

availableCommands.description: Run a reviewer subagent against your whole branch vs main, your uncommitted working state, a named branch, a single GitHub PR, or an entire Graphite/stacked-PR stack (one reviewer subagent per PR). A bare /review defaults to reviewing your uncommitted working state when the tree is dirty, or your whole branch vs main when the tree is clean. Main, local, and branch modes write a review file plus a summary to disk. PR and stack modes post the findings as a PENDING GitHub review for the user to inspect and submit through the UI. Use --main for an explicit clean-tree branch review, --stack for stacked PRs, --submit to publish immediately as COMMENT, or --approve to publish and approve; the default remains PENDING.
